title: Quick-Quenched uruguayan yeasty, glassy-jelly Wrap
description: A fast and flavorful Uruguayan dish, featuring ginger and coconut cream, served in a pandan leaf wrap. This recipe is perfect for a quick dinner or snack.
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a bowl to activate the yeast, let it sit for 5 minutes.
Mix flour, ginger, pandan extract, soy sauce, coconut sugar, and salt in a separate bowl.
Melt butter in a pan and add in the dry mixture, stir until combined.
Add in coconut cream and water, stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased pandan leaf and fold the edges to seal the wrap.
Cook in a pan with low heat for 2 minutes on each side, or until the wrap is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Let the wrap cool for a few minutes before serving.
Slice into wedges and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional ginger slices if desired.
